notes.title: World of Mines Creator's Edition 2.0 Update
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone, 

Today, the team is really happy to launch World of Mines Creator's Edition version 2.0.
Our main focus for this major update was to make it a more immersive Steam Workshop game. Version 1.0 used to be a minesweeper game with a world map twist, but now we have made major improvements in many areas of the game. Hence we have taken the 1.0 version into a classic mode. 

So let's take a look like how the game has improved. 

Our Main home provides a scroll view of many different themes. 
We wanted to make it much easier to find interesting pixel mines levels. 
The community now has over 150 user created workshop levels. We greatly appreciate the awesome creators who have made this possible. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42253148/a76d029f728560a15a32ee4c5923ee02d03fd5bb.gif

Most importantly, we have technically re-created the editor. Available now, players can focus on creating your favorite pixel art with so many more colors without the need to purchase them using mines. 
We really hope that players can unleash their creativity using this powerful tool. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42253148/d05a618dc465bc9417ecbf92bed3e9e805d9cd4a.gif

We tried really hard to keep the original essence of the Steam Workshop game. 
We also tried to stick to our original concept "Classic PC game with a twist". 
We wanted to make the best time killing game even better. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42253148/5d944ffc1a45a80273bff93a8b975f920412cc89.gif


We look forward to seeing the community grow along with many more pixel art levels coming up. 

Many thanks, 

Team Cogoo

notes.title: [Coming Soon] Version 2.0 Major Update Devlog
notes.notes:
Dear All, 

Today we are very happy to announce that version 2.0 will be updated in the near future. 

Recently, one of our players(@Nemexis) spent about 20 hours to make a workshop map called Starry Night. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42253148/d804f638c0bf7f07ab829d9b6f49474614929978.png

Here is a link the The Starry Night map. 
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2915843762

We were so surprised and inspired, the team has decided to go Version 2.0.
Thank you so much for taking the effort to inspire our community of players Nemexis. 
 You helped us to wake up to more possibilities. 
We believe current players will most likely be surprised by the update, as we believe it can look and feel like a different game. 

So here is what we are updating on Version 2.0. 

1) We are turning all creator's edition highlighting the Workshop in Steam. 
- Improved palette for pixel art. 
- Many more colors(No more spending mines to unlock new colors).
- New auto save featured will be supported as Nemexis requested. 
- Current two step edition(Tile making & Pixel Art) will be combined to 1 Step. Just focus on the pixel art and the tiles will be automatically created. 
- New short keys will be matched to the keyboards. (e.g., Number 1, 2, 3 for Brush tool, Eraser tool, Pipette tool)
- Thumbnail images can now be chosen by the editor/creator (Hidden mode, Grayscale mode, Full Color) 

2) New Gallery Mode 
- Players will be able to view their pixel art collection (Created by map creators in the workshop) under a new Gallery mode. 
- New sorting algorithm of your collection 

3) World Map feature 
- This feature and content will move to 'Classic World of Mines' 
- Your world map will still be there, but it will be pushed back in terms of priority to make the game more creator oriented. 
- All classic colors available for coloring will be unlocked. 

We believe the game can support more pixel art creators to enjoy and focus on the art and unleash creativity. 

Thank you so much to all the creators in our workshop community. 

Cheers, 

Team Cogoo 
- Please fell free to questions on the comments. =)

notes.title: World of Mines Creator's Edition 1.3.0 Update
notes.notes:
2022.07.15

World of Mines Creator's Edition 1.3.0 Update
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42253148/435967d45d2fb80cd3ada3bdeed2fe478394ee2b.png

New Features and Minor Updates!

New Features :


 'Wallpaper' features
 
  Added some benefits into the 'Wallpaper'
  You can apply the different Wallpaper not only to enjoy different background design but also different benefits in the game
  Different Wallpaper provides different benefits to you
  Benefits : 
    
    Obtain more mines (All Wallpapers except basic, each Wallpaper has different rate to get more)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42253148/6f8faef8d2783de644fd8157a42acaa7844db4b9.png
    Discount mine numbers for 'Undo' (Currently only for Green Field)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42253148/86e5a2b6e362a15560e774c28e31f8be41a05cd8.png
    Free 'Undo' (Currently only for Christmas Wallpaper)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42253148/a491c2a020044d4a0989cb60c9b907918886064d.png
    
  You can find the detailed Wallpaper's benefits in the   World of Mines Creator's Edition - Official Guideline (Ver. 1.3.0)   
 
 'Workshop' features 
 
  Added 'Pixel Art' in the Workshop
    
    After creating your map, now you are able to color your tile map in the Workshop Editor

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42253148/42f1199e5fafe43a0c018ff794528c9f204aae93.png
    
  Varied 'Difficulty Level' of your map in the Workshop Editor
    
    You can set the difficulty level either by Difficulty Level or by Mine Numbers

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42253148/75bf0ea872ca8be31ab78dbbd80a459b8a47e3e5.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42253148/7c0d54e64c10144da3081583279f8a2bea5850ae.png
    
  Added 'Visibility' option to set your map as 'Public' easier in the Workshop Editor
    
    You can check the Checkbox to set your map as PUBLIC in the Upload Map window

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42253148/5261bd96fa871771235926642e168a1587bb389a.png
    
  Added 'Help' feature for the Workshop Editor
    
    You can find 'Question' Icons in the Workshop Editor and Pixel Art to see the Brief Manual

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42253148/8be2beaead19bd9c4679efeaa2be5a28daeb734e.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42253148/5e573b16d14d66b749e7ba73724ff244deaef187.png
    
  You can find the detailed Workshop features in the   World of Mines Creator's Edition -Official Workshop Guideline (Ver. 1.3.0)   
  

Bug Fixes and Misc :


 Minor bug fixed
 Minor localization updated
  
  @Grobi Thank you so much for your support! We've corrected and updated some German words as you suggested!!
  

User-Recommended Update!

Some other recommendations and requests are not included in this update since we are still working on those! Please wait until the next update!!


Again,
We listened to your suggestion!
You said you want it. We want it, too!

- Team Cogoo -
